introduce: Lie on your back in front of a wall, place your feet on the wall, with knees slightly bent. Inhale and raise your arms overhead.\n\nPut your left ankle on your right thigh. Adjust the bend in your right leg until you feel a noticeable stretch in your left hip. Hold this position.
name: WALL PIGEON POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please prepare a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Make sure your lower back is firmly against the mat and remains relaxed.
This exercise stretches your glutes.

introduce: Lie on your back in front of a wall, place your feet on the wall, with knees slightly bent. Inhale and raise your arms overhead.\n\nPut your right ankle on your left thigh. Adjust the bend in your left leg until you feel a noticeable stretch in your right hip. Hold this position.
name: WALL PIGEON POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please prepare a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Make sure your lower back is firmly against the mat and remains relaxed.
This exercise stretches your glutes.

introduce:
Lie on your back in front of a wall with your buttocks close to the wall. Place your legs against the wall and your hands on your abdomen.

As you exhale, bend your legs, open your knees to the sides, and put the soles of your feet together.

Slide your heels down to your groins. Inhale while maintaining loose hips.

Attempt a deeper stretch with each exhalation. Hold this position.
name: WALL BUTTERFLY POSE

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please prepare a mat.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
Make sure your lower back is firmly against the mat and remains relaxed.
You can feel a nice stretch in your groin.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Straighten your arms up towards the ceiling.

Open your knees while extending your arms out to the sides, keeping your chest wide.

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL BUTTERFLY WITH CHEST OPENER

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.
Inhale as you open your knees, and exhale as you bring them together.
It strengthens hip abductors.
It helps improve hip flexibility and stretches the inner thighs.
It develops stronger chest and arm muscles.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Put your arms straight over the top of your head.

Lift your upper body off the floor, then slowly go back to the starting position.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL LONG ARM CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Keep your neck in a neutral position by avoiding any forward tilting.
Keep your chin slightly tucked towards your chest.
Avoid using your arms to propel your body upwards.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
Exhale when lifting, and inhale when lowering.
The exercise increases abdominal endurance.

introduce:
Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Put both hands in front of your chest.

Rotate your torso from side to side.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL RUSSIAN TWIST

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Focus on rotating from your thoracic spine rather than just moving your arms.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Keep your legs still.
Tighten your abs.
Exhale as you rotate your torso to one side.
Inhale while returning your torso to the center position.
This primarily targets your internal and external obliques.

introduce:
Lift into a plank position, with your hands crossed on the floor. Bend your legs against the wall with knees on the floor.

Lift your hips up towards your feet, while maintaining the plank position with your upper body. Then, lower your hips.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL KNEE PLANK & HIP EXTENSION

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your hands crossed firmly on the floor to stabilize your upper body.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Put your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Inhale as you lower, exhale as you lift your hips.
It strengthens the glutes and abs.

introduce:
Start in a plank position with your arms extended straight. Keep your feet shoulder-width apart and against the wall.

Push your hips up and back into an upside-down "V" shape.

Return to the starting position, and repeat.
name: WALL STRAIGHT ARM PLANK TO PIKE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Your head should be in line with your arms when lifting your hips.
Keep your core tight to maintain stability.
Exhale as you lift your hips, and inhale as you return to the plank position.
It develops abs and hamstrings.

introduce:
Start in a plank position with your arms extended straight. Keep your feet shoulder-width apart and against the wall.

Lift your hips up as high as possible, while walking your hands backward. Then, lower your knees to the ground.

Return to the starting position, and repeat.
name: WALL INCHWORMS

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Tighten your core.
This exercise targets the shoulders, core and hamstrings.
Exhale as you lift your hips and walk your hands back, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
It develops abs and hamstrings.

introduce:
Start in a kneeling plank position. Place your forearms on the ground, parallel to the wall. Bend your legs against the wall with knees on the floor.

Rotate your upper body, while extending one arm up.

Return to the starting position, switch sides, and repeat it.
name: WALL KNEELING ELBOW PLANK ROTATION

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Inhale when you rotate your body up, and exhale when you return.
This exercise works on your middle deltoid and core.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides. Lift your hips off the ground. 

Bring one knee in towards your chest, then return to the starting position.

Switch legs and repeat it.
name: WALL BUTT BRIDGE HOLD & BENT LEG RAISES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your glutes to lift your hips.
Keep your waist, hips, and knees aligned.
Keep your neck and shoulders relaxed.
Exhale as you bring your knees, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
This strengthens the glutes, hip flexors, and hamstrings.

introduce:
Lie on your back with hips against the wall. Extend your legs with your heels resting against the wall and your arms relaxed by your sides.

Engage your abs to lift your hips off the floor, then return to the starting position.

Repeat it.
name: WALL HEELS TO THE HEAVENS

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your glutes to lift your hips.
Keep your waist, hips, and knees aligned.
Keep your legs straight.
Exhale as you raise, and inhale as you lower down.
This exercise targets your lower abs.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides. 

Lift your hips off the ground. Bend one knee towards your chest and rotate it in small circles counterclockwise, then down towards your chest, and return to the starting position.

Switch legs and repeat.
name: WALL BUTT BRIDGE HOLD & BENT LEG CIRCLES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core muscles.
Ensure that your supporting leg and hips remain stable.
Keep your neck and shoulders relaxed.
Exhale during the knee circles, and inhale as you return your foot to the wall.
This workout strengthens the glutes, hamstrings, and hip flexors.
